This is a lesson on one drum groove the [Backing Track](../../tools/backing-track.qmd) band plays: **Ride pattern (learning swing, 2)**. It is built up from a simpler pattern, one step at a time, and every step is played by the band and written out as it plays. How the examples work: press ▶ Play, switch players in and out with the buttons beside it, and read the band's last four bars on the staff underneath. The tempo slider at the bottom of the page slows everything down.

[All the accompaniment patterns](index.qmd) · [Drum grooves](index.qmd#drums)

## The pattern

The swing ride pattern and nothing else: the cymbal on every beat with a skip note before 3 and before 1 (ding, ding-a, ding, ding-a), and the hi-hat foot on 2 and 4.

It belongs in *Swing* and *Jazz ballad*. Here it is in the swing style with the whole band. Switch the other players off to hear it alone.

## Step 1: Quarter notes (learning swing, 1)

Start with something simpler. Only the beat: the cymbal on 1, 2, 3 and 4 and the hi-hat foot on 2 and 4. No kick, no snare, no fills. The first thing to play on a blues.

This is a pattern of its own: [the lesson on it](drums-quarters.qmd) takes it further. Here it is only a step on the way, slowly. The drums play alone first; switch the bass and chords on when it is steady.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="swing" data-chart="Dm7|G7|Cmaj7|A7|Dm7|G7|Cmaj7|Cmaj7" data-tempo="84" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Step:" data-choices='[{"label":"Quarter notes (learning swing, 1)","opts":{"groove":"quarters"}}]'></div>

## Step 2: Ride pattern (learning swing, 2), slowly

Now the pattern itself. Compare it with the step before: press each button while the band plays and watch what changes on the staff.

**How to play it.** Ding, ding-a, ding, ding-a: the ride on every beat, with a swung skip note before 3 and before 1. The hi-hat foot stays on 2 and 4.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="swing" data-chart="Dm7|G7|Cmaj7|A7|Dm7|G7|Cmaj7|Cmaj7" data-tempo="84" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Compare:" data-choices='[{"label":"Ride pattern (learning swing, 2)","opts":{"groove":"ridetime"}},{"label":"Quarter notes (learning swing, 1) (the step before)","opts":{"groove":"quarters"}}]'></div>

## Step 3: Up to tempo, with the band

The whole band, at 120 beats a minute. Play along, then switch the band's drum kit off and take the part yourself.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="swing" data-chart="Dm7|G7|Cmaj7|A7|Dm7|G7|Cmaj7|Cmaj7" data-tempo="120" data-on="bass comp drums congas" data-staves="drums bass" data-choice-label="Drum groove:" data-choices='[{"label":"Ride pattern (learning swing, 2)","opts":{"groove":"ridetime"}}]'></div>
